intake.description: Heavy rain caused surface water to enter the basement store room of the insured property, soaking and ruining stored items including a sofa set, mattresses, books, and winter clothes. The estimated value of the damaged items is Rs 1,10,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-56602 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.
We do not pay for damage caused by flood (PROP-DEF-1.4). This exclusion is amended by PROP-END-6.1.
It still applies to contents kept below ground level, such as in a basement or cellar.

coverage.reasoning: Heavy rain caused surface water to enter the basement, which constitutes a flood under PROP-DEF-1.4 and is normally covered under PROP-COV-2.3 subject to flood exclusions. However, PROP-EXC-4.3 excludes flood damage and PROP-END-6.1 explicitly maintains this exclusion for contents kept below ground level, such as in a basement. Since the ruined items were stored in the basement, the claim is not covered.
